svg.title: Gold Master normalized-shape comparison
svg.desc: Visual-only comparison with changed geometry parameters normalized for shape comparison; it must not supply quantitative readings.

svg.title: 25 mL acid burette, Class AS, master
svg.desc: Ex calibrated top-zero burette. Reading values increase downward on the marking printed around the tube.

svg.title: 50 mL alkali burette master
svg.desc: Distinct alkali burette family with an approximate top-zero downward reading scale, rubber delivery tube and glass bead.

svg.title: 250 mL Griffin low-form beaker master
svg.desc: Source-backed approximate-contained scale from 25 mL to 200 mL, increasing upward on the vessel wall.

svg.title: 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask master
svg.desc: Source-backed conical flask silhouette with a cylindrical neck and no invented measurement scale.

svg.text: Not measurement evidence. Use the physical-scale sheet for common millimetre scale.
